version: r27 (final-2 of 2026-09-29 with the r27 changes: claws on dagger rows, condition durability, D6 retier planned)

speedNorm.rule: s = clamp(cycle(recordSpeed) / cycle(rowSpeed), 0.4, 1.0); final damage x s; melee rate limit = 0.888 x cycle(typeSpeed) x s. Records slower than their row are set to the row speed in the ESP, so s <= 1 never costs DPS

rangedLimits.hitArrival: unchanged from today: 0.77 / speed (speed > 0.75), else 0.605 / speed (crossbow 0.77 s)
rangedLimits.shotInterval: 0.888 x draw cycle x s (bows; x 0.7 with the Hunter QuickShot perk) or 0.888 x 1.9 s (crossbows), checked at PlayerBowShot, log-only first

sneak.rule: accepted only if the aggressor has been sneaking for >= 1 s; against a player target, the target must also have dealt, taken and blocked no hit for 10 s (first strike). Otherwise the hit counts as a normal hit

power.npcFlags: trusted from the hosting client (AnimationSystem sees only the sender's own actor), bounded by x1.25 (creatures) / x2 (humanoids) and the 45 cap
power.rule: a player power flag counts only if one unconsumed attackPowerStart* event from that aggressor arrived within 1.6 s; the event validates every hit landing inside the 0.1 s splash window of its first hit (Sweep); power hits at least 1.5 s apart. No stamina check. Log-only until a play test measures the false-refusal rate

wrappersAfter: DamageMultConditional (hunterOverDraw x1.2 for Hunter Master bows/crossbows vs NPCs; practiceArrows x0 on Test)

order: blocked: a player on a player -> 0 with an intact shield or weapon, a broken shield (or a parry with a broken weapon) lets durability.effect.brokenBlockPass x the unblocked post-DT damage through (durability design 3.2.4); an NPC on a player -> the unblocked post-DT damage x npcBlockedDamageShare (the top-level server setting of r28 G10, not part of this block), or x durability.effect.brokenBlockPass when larger for a broken shield or weapon; a blocked hit stays flagged blocked in every case (no poison, no disease); dummy / staff rows -> 0 (the hit is ignored)
base damage: weapons[row].base x weaponTypes[type].dmgMult (override > keyword > AldCatMat > fallback)
tempering x(1 + 0.015 q)
validated dagger sneak -> crit; bash x0.30 and never crits
crit roll (server RNG): damage x critMult
creature natural attack on a player: damage capped at 45 before DT
target DT: one piece per slot (head slots merged), temper x(1 + 0.015 q), light item on heavy row x0.7, + shield 6%, + creature natural DT; crit -> DT x0.5
penetration: DT x (1 - pen)
subtract with floor: max(D - DTe, floor x D, 0.5)
power x2 (creatures x1.25) or validated sneak x sneakMult, whichever is bigger (they never stack)
speed normalisation x s (s <= 1)
player -> NPC x playerToNpcMult
existing wrappers (DamageMult, DamageMultConditional)
poison: + max(P - DT, 0.5 P), unblocked non-bash hits only
cap: min(total, 45) when the target is a player

dagger.label: Dagger
dagger.niche: fastest; 30% crits at x2 that halve DT dig into plate; the opener

sword.label: Sword
sword.niche: all-rounder; best 1H against light armor and cloth

mace.label: Mace
mace.niche: 1H armor breaker: ignores 15% of DT, steady hits

warhammer.label: Warhammer
warhammer.niche: biggest hit, ignores 15% of DT: anti-plate

bow.label: Bow
bow.interval: hit arrival: today's limit; shots: 0.888 x draw cycle (log-only)
bow.niche: range; only a raised shield blocks it

crossbow.label: Crossbow
crossbow.interval: hit arrival: today's 0.77 s; shots: 0.888 x 1.9 s (log-only)
crossbow.niche: Dawnguard faction weapon: the bolt ignores half of DT; slower than a bow against cloth

unarmed.label: Unarmed
unarmed.niche: brawling: fists ignore half of DT and keep at least half their damage

natural.label: Creature natural attack
natural.niche: critters bite through half of DT; big creatures are capped at 45 before DT and meet full DT; never crit

weaponsNote: damage = base x weaponTypes[type].dmgMult, unrounded (damageDisplay is rounded for tables only)

DraugrHoned.label: Ancient Nord Honed / Nord Hero Bow

Crossbow.label: Crossbow and Enhanced Crossbow (steel; Woodworker Novice + Dawnguard)

Dwarven.label: Dwarven and Enhanced Dwarven Crossbow (Woodworker Expert + Dawnguard)

bows.crossbowRule: row by material keyword (WeapMaterialSteel -> Crossbow, WeapMaterialDwarven -> Dwarven); DLC1CrossbowIsEnhanced changes nothing (same recipe rank as its plain version)

arrows.rule: bonus = clamp(0.25 x (AMMO DATA damage - 8), 0, 4), read from the arrow the server saw fired (OnPlayerBowShot), else the worn AMMO

unarmed.raceKey: RACE editor id, resolved on first use like the keywords; claws use the row and type of a weapon (its damage, crit, penetration and floor) at the unarmed swing, never tempered, never worn, no poison
unarmed.source: settings for playable races; a playable race without a raceOverride entry hits with base and the fist rules; non-playable races use RACE.unarmedDamage as a creature natural attack

Leather.label: Leather (Thieves Guild, Vampire, Hunter, Nightingale, Dark Brotherhood)

SteelPlate.label: Steel Plate (Blades, Tullius, IA Advanced Plate, cc Golden)

armorRules.slotDT: piece DT = set DT x slot share; shares cuirass 0.60, helmet 0.15, gauntlets 0.125, boots 0.125 (the average weight split of the vanilla sets, so mixing light and heavy pieces stays on the light-heavy line)

slots.head: biped 30, 31, 41, 42, 43 merged: only the highest-DT head piece counts
slots.other: any other slot (44-61, rings 36, amulets 35) adds 0

armorRules.enchantDamageResist: ignored (no DT from enchantments; none exist in the load order today)
armorRules.lightToHeavy: light sets carry about 80% of the same-tier heavy DT

blockStamina.rule: a blocked hit costs the blocker base (Warrior 0.05) x (1 + 0.006 x min(worn armor weight, 115)) of max stamina (server TS, needsSystem.ts); heavy armor tires a guard faster

tempering.practicalCeiling: q5 (Master rank; Legendary rank needs 6000 h and path B must be closed first)

durability.model: B (r27): a per-copy condition 0..1 on Inventory::ExtraData; each row has an HP pool of wear points; tempering stays a permanent quality
durability.fallbackMaterialRule: generated per kind and row: the ingredient most temper recipes (ArmorTable, SharpeningWheel) of that row's playable records use; a row without a temper recipe takes fallbackMaterialDefault[kind][row], else [kind]['*']

npc.creatureDamageSource: RACE.unarmedDamage of the non-playable race (the creatures table copies it for the sim and the calculator)
npc.creatureVariantsNote: variants: sibling RACE records of the same creature that take its DT (plan correction of the r27a review); an armored troll keeps the plain troll's DT until the owner gives it more. Every other non-playable race with unarmed damage has no natural DT, and report.md lists them for the owner

order: form-id override (generated settings: plugin:localid -> row; template variants included)
specific keyword (DLC, cc, Honed, Gilded, SteelPlate, IronBanded) in list order
generic WeapMaterial*/ArmorMaterial*
mod aliases (IAKMaterial*, MCE_*, WAF_*, TH_*)
owner AldCatMat_* keyword
fallback (logged once per base id)
keywordMap.multiKeyword: an item with 3 or more IAKMaterial keywords goes to the fallback (IA multi-material pieces); otherwise the first keyword in list order wins (the lists run specific before generic)
keywordMap.weaponType: WEAP DNAM animType: OneHandDagger/Sword/Axe/Mace, TwoHandSword, TwoHandAxe (+ WeapTypeWarhammer keyword = warhammer, else battleaxe), Bow, Crossbow; HandToHand = unarmed row; Staff = 0 (staves never melee)

fallback.weapon: Iron row of its type (Novice); bow: Long row; crossbow: Crossbow row

keywordMap.recipeRankAudit: generator step (misc/combat-settings): a craftable item (WEAP incl. bows and crossbows, ARMO) whose row is above its recipe rank is overridden to the reference row of that rank; the override also covers every template variant of that record; _CLS closed-helmet conversions are exempt
overridesArmor: Ancient Nord armor (and its enchanted variants) keyed ArmorMaterialDaedric
NPC-only Ancient Nord pieces 001019CA-CD keyed Daedric
Dragon Priest, Miraak and Acolyte masks, Jagged Crown: keyed Daedric, weight 2-9
9 hold shields keyed Iron+Stormcloak, AR 17 weight 3
Emperor / Titus Mede sets and Savior's Hide keyed Ebony
Bandit fur set, no material keyword
Dawnguard Falmer heavy set (Tailor Novice recipe), no keyword
Nightingale and Dark Brotherhood sets: Expert light (faction gear)
overridesWeapons: tools: Wood row (pickaxes carry WeapMaterialIron + WeapTypeWarAxe)
never a real hit: damage 0, the hit is ignored
Novice recipes keyed Steel or Elven: capped at their recipe rank
Daedric artifacts with no or wrong keyword: Legendary row
Rueful Axe, Ebony Blade, Nightingale blade and bow (all levels): Master row
Falmer bows have no material keyword
Forsworn bow is keyed WeapMaterialSteel: Forsworn bow row
keywordMap.generator: misc/combat-settings/generate.py resolves the override regexes and the recipe-rank audit against the Test load order into {"<hex local id>:<plugin>": row} (the server FormDesc) for every matching record and every template variant, and writes alduinakDamageFormulaSettings.overrides; rerun after every Update Modlist and every plugin change

notes: All tuning lives in server-settings.json -> alduinakDamageFormulaSettings (gitignored live file; restart to retune). The block is protected from Migrate settings (PROTECTED_SETTINGS) and is copied to live by hand at sign-off.
Weights, record speeds and the tooltip sync live in AlduinakAdditions.esp (Mutagen patcher); a server table cannot change them.
Magic is out of scope except the 45 cap on player-targeted spell hits: spells stay on TES5DamageFormula and ignore DT.
Weapon enchantments do nothing in the server hit path today (critic G4) and are unchanged.
Hit counts are to DOWN (0 HP); a downed player needs one more hit of any damage to be finished.
Without the alduinakDamageFormulaSettings block (or with enabled false) every new ActionListener behaviour is off and the server behaves exactly as today.

Blocked NPC hits (ADDENDUM, r28 G10): the formula reads npcBlockedDamageShare from the top level of server-settings.json, the same key the block lane reads for today's formula; this block never carries a second copy.

recipeRetier.comment: D6: the vanilla Studded and Scaled forge recipes move to the documented Tailor ladder in plugin r27b; generate.py --assume-retier applies these ranks to the recipe-rank audit before that plugin exists
